readings.st_branch: reading A (default, desk code): in the 'ST on FLB' branch ST = FLB if close >= FLB else FUB; B = FLB if close < FUB else FUB was the first reading and disagrees on I5
readings.ema_seed: EMA at the N-th bar = mean of the first N closes, recursion from bar N+1
readings.valuation_ffill: stock valuation close = last close on D18 dates (all D18 dates, including non-calendar ones) forward-filled onto the calendar
readings.n_k_basket: n, k, kept of decision j = stored pass set of review r(j) intersect the basket in force at its trade session (decision session for the last decision); BUY rows logged with the same definition
readings.review_flag: T05.md 5a: last decision of its calendar month by its own date, or first SELL decision of a spell (j=0 if SELL); computed for every decision; n_reviews counts flagged SELL decisions (last included), n_reviews_traded excludes the last decision
readings.null_row: u[r(j)] with default_rng([5, i, draw_id]).random((J, N)); k = |P(j) intersect b|
readings.constant_mix: always trades at event sessions; initial stock holding = drifted basket scaled by f; sleeve (1-f)/2 each
readings.null_draw_ids: draws 0..19 plus 20 random ids (different per indicator and variant, seed 777)
readings.evidence_rows_valid: valid = a bar exists within 7 calendar days of the decision date
